## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the accepted scope or assignment.

## Validation

List executed checks and results; distinguish remaining acceptance gates.

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run build:ui:svelte`
- [ ] For UI changes: real-browser interactions and desktop/narrow screenshots in supported themes, with independent screenshot review and findings resolved.
- [ ] Public examples, provenance and relevant documentation updated where required.

## Review notes

Record material limitations, independent findings and responses separately from approval.
